description: This is a shell script used for releasing software versions, performing tasks such as determining changes since the last release, mapping changes to components via metadata.yaml files, and computing version bumps based on labels and heuristics. It includes functions for handling Git operations, parsing PR labels, and updating metadata files.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Displays usage information for the script.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Outputs informational messages to the terminal.

methods.name: warn
methods.description: Outputs warning messages to standard error.

methods.name: die
methods.description: Outputs an error message and exits the script.

methods.name: get_pr_for_commit
methods.description: Fetches the pull request number associated with a specific commit SHA, using cached data or falling back to GitHub API if enabled.

methods.name: get_pr_labels
methods.description: Retrieves labels associated with a specific pull request, with cache support.

methods.name: component_from_path
methods.description: Determines which component metadata directory a given file path belongs to.

methods.name: is_doc_like_path
methods.description: Checks if a file path resembles documentation or related files.

methods.name: compute_next_versions
methods.description: Calculates the next version and generation based on current data and bump type.

methods.name: update_metadata
methods.description: Updates the version and generation fields in a component's metadata.yaml.
